ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT(Agreement")ismade as of the 3rd day of November 2022 by and between 88 CLINTON LLC having an address at 88 Clinton Street, Suite 3A, New York, NY 10002 ("88 Owner"), and 86 CLINTON LLC having an address at 88 Clinton Street, Suite 3A, New York, NY 10002 ("86 Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,88Owner is theownerinfeeof certainland,with thebuildingand improvements thereon, in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, known by the street address88ClintonStreet,NewYork,NewYork,designated asLot43inBlock348on the described on Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “88 Owner Land,”" said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein called the “88 Owner Building,” and the 88 Owner Land and the 88 Owner Building being herein collectively called the “88 Owner Premises"); and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, known by the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “86 Owner Building,” and the 86 Owner Land and the 86 Owner Building being herein collectively called the“86OwnerPremises"); WHEREAS, there are certain“Floor Area Development Rights"(as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the 86 Owner Land that are in excess of the “86 Owner Floor Area Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) and that were and/or are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution (the “Excess Floor Area Development Rights"); WHEREAS, by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, dated August 23, 2013 and recorded September 21, 2013 under CRFN 2013000389947 (the “Declaration"), the 88 Owner Premises and the 86 Owner Premises were declared to constitute a single zoninglot (the“Merged Zoning Lot"); WHEREAS, more recently, all parties-in-interest, as defined in the Zoning Resolution, to the Merged Zoning Lot as shown on the Certification of Parties-in-Interest recorded simultaneouslyherewithhaveeither executed anupdatedDeclaration orhavewaivedor have previously subordinated their respective interests in the Merged Zoning Lot hereto;
